scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Living as a Mechanic is tough,
but I am happy that I can
always do what I want.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
作为机匠的日子虽然辛苦，
但能一直做自己想做的事，
我感到很幸福。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
There's nothing to say specifically about Mechanics or magic machinery.
You would know more about it than anyone now.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
关于机匠或魔法机械，
没有什么特别要说的了。
现在你应该比任何人都更了解它们了。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[链心]
你正骑着宠物，
所以无法转职。
请卸下坐骑后再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
What is it? Is that you?
Oh wait, you look quite different than the last time I saw you.
Did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[链心]
是你吗？
哎呀，你看起来和上次见面时很不一样。
发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
It seems something not enough?
scripts.translation:
[链心]
看起来似乎还缺些什么？

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
By the way, Franklson is missing.
He said that he wanted to study
and then disappeared.
Where could he have gone?
scripts.translation:
[链心]
对了，弗兰克松不见了。
他说想去学习，然后就消失了。
他到底去了哪里呢？

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
I think I've done all the explanations, is there anything else you want to know?
scripts.translation:
[链心]
我想我已经解释得够清楚了，
你还有什么想知道的吗？

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Ok let me catch my breath.
You must be interested in
magic machinery and the
world of Mechanics.
Ok, so let me explain.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
好了，让我喘口气。
你一定对魔法机械和机匠的世界很感兴趣。
好吧，让我来解释一下。

scripts.text: [Chainheart]
scripts.translation: [链心]

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
At a glance, you, seem to be a very versatile person on dealing with various things.
You look quite skilled.
You can be the one.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
乍一看，你似乎是个处理各种事务都很全能的人。
你看起来很有技巧。
你可以胜任这个角色。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
You look like someone who has a great sense on dealing with stuff.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
你看起来是个在处理事情上很有感觉的人。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Continue to grow your knowledge by experiencing what the world has to offer.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
通过体验世界所提供的一切，
继续增长你的见识吧。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Ahh! You went to Juperos
like I said. As Franklson did.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
啊！你像我说的去了朱佩罗斯，
就像弗兰克松那样。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
It seems there's no need
for more questioning.
I'm certain that you've gained the knowledge to be a true mechanic.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
看来不需要再问什么了。
我确信你已经获得了成为真正机匠的知识。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
There's nothing I can say more.
You are already a great Mechanic.
Don't lose your nerves with the
title. The most important thing is that you have the knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
我没有更多可以说的了。
你已经是一位出色的机匠了。
不要因为头衔而紧张。
最重要的是你拥有知识。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
You don't seem to be the type to be locked up inside a lab or in a library.
You are a type who learns
by actively participating.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
你似乎不是那种会被困在实验室或图书馆里的人。
你是那种通过积极参与来学习的人。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
I like who you are and I think we need that kind of a new blood for our Mechanics.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
我喜欢你的个性，
我觉得我们的机匠团体需要像你这样的新鲜血液。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Science is seeking and studying things that can be proven logically.
Ironically enough, science usually starts from uncertain theories just like magic.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
科学是探索和研究那些可以被逻辑证明的事物。
讽刺的是，科学通常也像魔法一样，
始于不确定的理论。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
As I said before if the passion and the talent are real there would be no problem!
Congratulations for walking through a new path as a Mechanic!
scripts.translation:
[链心]
正如我之前所说，如果热情和天赋是真实的，那就没问题！
恭喜你作为机匠踏上一条新的道路！

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
This is a gift that I give to you.
If you keep this well, one day
you'll be thankful to me.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
这是我送给你的礼物。
如果你好好保管它，
总有一天你会感谢我的。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Well, go. This wide world is
your laboratory, everything in
this world is going to be your
textbook, so let there be a silver lining in the future of Mechanics!
scripts.translation:
[链心]
去吧。这广阔的世界就是你的实验室，
世间万物都将成为你的教科书，
愿机匠的未来充满希望！

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
If you keep walking the way to being a Mechanic you might bump into him.
Fate works in weird ways friend.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
如果你继续走在成为机匠的道路上，
也许你会遇到他。
命运总是以奇怪的方式运作，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Anyway, farewell.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
总之，再见。

scripts.text: I want to know more.
scripts.translation: 我想知道更多。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Um..? You want to know more about magic machinery. Is that it?
Hmm... I told you that you are talented it's difficult.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
嗯...？你想了解更多关于魔法机械的事？是吗？
嗯...我说过你有天赋，这很难说。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Well, you seem talented, so it wouldn't be bad for us if you could become a Mechanic.
But unfortunately it doesn't
work just like that.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
嗯，你看起来很有天赋，
如果你能成为机匠，对我们来说也不坏。
但不幸的是，事情没那么简单。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
The mechanic scholars won't just acknowledge you that easily and hand you the knowledge without you showing true effort first.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
机匠学者们不会轻易认可你，
也不会在你没有展现出真正的努力之前就把知识传授给你。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Of course, I'm one of those scholars so I guess I can try to consider you.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
当然，我也是那些学者之一，
所以我想我可以试着考虑一下你。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Anyhow, I just think it's unfair to exclude someone who's talented without any test.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
无论如何，我认为不经过测试就排除有天赋的人是不公平的。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Hmm...

[Chainheart]
Actually, if somebody can't teach you, you can learn by yourself.
If someone else can do it then anyone can figure it out for themself too right?
scripts.translation:
[链心]
实际上，如果没人教你，你可以自学。
如果别人能做到，那么任何人自己也能弄清楚，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
It won't be easy but if your passion is strong and your talent is real then there shouldn't be any problems.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
这不会容易，但如果你的热情强烈，天赋真实，
那么应该不会有问题的。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Come to think of it...
Franklson developed the
magic machinery on his own.
So why don't you go to
the Ruins of Juperos?
scripts.translation:
[链心]
说起来...
弗兰克松是独自开发魔法机械的。
所以，你不妨去一下朱佩罗斯废墟看看？

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
As I told you before, if your passion and talent are real, you will definitely find something.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
正如我之前所说，如果你的热情和天赋是真实的，
你一定会找到什么的。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Find out the knowledge
for yourself like we did.
Don't just wait around for someone to teach it to you. Show the passion that you claim to have.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
像我们一样，自己去寻找知识。
不要只是等着别人教你。展现出你声称拥有的热情。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Anyway, whatever your choice might be I expect you to do your best.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
总之，无论你的选择是什么，我都期望你尽力而为。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
What a strange person.
I thought that you had what it took to be a true Mechanic.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
真是个奇怪的人。
我以为你具备成为真正机匠的潜质。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Magic machinery was born by a fusion between machines and magic.
The two haven't really been connected successfully together until now.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
魔法机械是机器与魔法融合的产物。
直到目前为止，这两者还没有真正成功地结合在一起。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
If you use the magic machinery, you really have to be familiar with the inner workings of machines.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
如果你使用魔法机械，
你必须非常熟悉机器的内部构造。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
It can be used effectively,
and you don't need to rely on something that's uncertain and unstable as magic, so what can be better than this.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
它可以被有效利用，
而且你不需要依赖像魔法那样不确定和不稳定的东西，
还有什么比这更好的呢。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
The person who invented magic machinery is Franklson, a scholar from the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
发明魔法机械的人是弗兰克松，他是来自修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的学者。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Franklson discovered an ancient machine in the ^FF0000Ruins of Juperos^000000 and fused it with the power of magic, and that was the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
弗兰克松在^FF0000朱诺废墟^000000发现了一台古代机器，并将其与魔法的力量融合，这就是魔法机械的起源。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
So naturally, Franklson named the newborn machine Magic Machinery.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
因此，弗兰克松自然地将这台新生的机器命名为“魔法机械”。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Anyway, since it hasn't been too well known to other places outside of Juno, the study of Magic Machinery has been progressing since.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
总之，由于魔法机械在朱诺以外的地方并不太为人所知，所以这项研究一直在持续进行。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Because we've researched
Magic Machinery endlessly
people started calling us ^FF0000Mechanics^000000.
The name is self-explanatory
so it just stuck.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
因为我们无止境地研究魔法机械，人们开始称我们为^FF0000机匠^000000。
这个名字不言自明，所以就一直沿用至今。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Hmm. Well I guess I'm done explaining Magic Machinery.
I want to explain more but it's too technical.
I don't want to bore you more.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
嗯。我想关于魔法机械的解释就到这里了。
虽然我还想多讲一些，但内容太专业了。
我不想让你感到无聊。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Anyway if you become one of us you can form your own definition and explanation of Mechanics yourself.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
总之，如果你加入我们，你可以自己定义和解释什么是机匠。

scripts.text:
At a glance, you, seem to be a very versatile person on dealing with various things.
You look quite skilled.
You can be the one.
scripts.translation:
乍一看，你似乎是个在处理各种事务方面非常多才多艺的人。
你看起来很有技巧。
你可以胜任这份工作。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Ah, I didn't introduce myself.
I am the famous Chainheart.
I'm a Mechanic.
Well, actually I'm not that famous.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
啊，我还没自我介绍。
我是著名的链心。
我是一名机匠。
嗯，其实我也没那么有名。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
I don't think the word Mechanic
is familiar to you.
In fact, when it comes
to the description,
it's a new job that can
be explained simply.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
我想“机匠”这个词对你来说可能很陌生。
事实上，就描述而言，
这是一个可以简单解释的新职业。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
One who studies and uses Magic Machinery, that is a Mechanic.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
研究和运用魔法机械的人，就是机匠。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
So, what is the Magic Machinery that a Mechanic studies and uses?
That isn't as simple to explain but I'll give it a try.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
那么，机匠研究和运用的魔法机械是什么呢？
这并不像刚才那样容易解释，但我试着说说看。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Sorry, I'm starting
to talk too much.
Let me catch my
breath for a while.
If you are interested,
please talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
抱歉，我好像说得太多了。
让我喘口气。
如果你感兴趣，请再和我谈谈。

scripts.text: You look like someone who has a great sense on dealing with stuff.
scripts.translation: 你看起来是个在处理事务方面很有感觉的人。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
That power has been used on
just dealing with simple things.
That isn't going to give
you true enjoyment.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
这种能力一直被用来处理简单的事情。
这并不能给你带来真正的乐趣。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Right... If you want to enjoy
true feelings of dealing and
a deep profoundness,
you need to handle
^FF0000Magic Machinery^000000!
scripts.translation:
[链心]
没错... 如果你想体验处理事务时的真正感受
以及深奥的内涵，
你需要操作^FF0000魔法机械^000000！

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Magic Machinery hasn't been
in the world long, so recognizing it is not common yet.
It's very precise and completely different from anything you've experienced in the world.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
魔法机械问世不久，所以人们还不太熟悉它。
它非常精密，与你在这个世界经历过的任何东西都完全不同。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Yeah, and the ones who deal with magic machinery are called ^FF0000Mechanics^000000.
I am also the one of those honorable mechanics.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
是的，那些处理魔法机械的人被称为^FF0000机匠^000000。
我也是这些受人尊敬的机匠之一。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
It seems like you have what it takes to be a good mechanic.
Here are the basic requirements.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
看来你具备成为一名优秀机匠的潜质。
这是基本要求。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
If you come to me after reaching ^FF0000Base level 99^000000 and ^FF0000Job level 50^000000,
I will guide you to the world of Mechanics.
scripts.translation:
[链心]
当你达到^FF0000基础等级 99^000000和^FF0000职业等级 50^000000后，
再来找我，我会引导你进入机匠的世界。

scripts.text:
Living as a Mechanic is tough,
but I am happy that I can
always do what I want.
scripts.translation:
作为机匠的生活虽然艰辛，
但我能一直做自己想做的事，
这让我感到幸福。

scripts.text:
[Chainheart]
Don't you also want to become a Mechanic and enjoy true happiness?
scripts.translation:
[链心]
难道你不想成为机匠，
去享受真正的幸福吗？

scripts.text:
- Your pack is too heavy. -
- Lighten your body first -
- and please try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你的背包太重了。 -
- 请先减轻负重 -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
How was Juperos?
I am so scared that I still
cannot go there.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
朱佩罗斯怎么样？
我害怕得
根本不敢去那里。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
^FF0000You won't be able to reach the destination by walking.
^FF0000Strong enemies are not the problem here, you just won't be able to get to the destination.
Please make yourself at home.^000000
scripts.translation:
[学者]
^FF0000你无法通过步行到达目的地。
^FF0000这里的强大敌人并不是问题，你只是无法到达目的地。
请自便。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
I am a scholar who came here to research the ruins here in Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
我是一名学者，
来这里研究朱佩罗斯的遗迹。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
However comfortable it may be,
I have no intention to go.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
无论那里多么舒适，
我都无意前往。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Okay then, Are you ready
to go to the midway point
at Juperos?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
那么，你准备好
前往朱佩罗斯的中途点了吗？

scripts.text: I am ready!
scripts.translation: 我准备好了！

scripts.text: Not yet
scripts.translation: 还没

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Uh... you are acting so firmly that I regret a little that I haven't gone there.
Should I have gone there? Uh... It's no use crying over spilled milk!
scripts.translation:
[学者]
呃... 你表现得如此坚定，
让我有点后悔自己没去过那里。
我是不是该去一趟？呃... 覆水难收啊！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Well, I'll send you.
I hope you get
the knowledge
you wanted.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
好吧，我会送你去。
希望你能获得
你想要的知识。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Umm... right. Of course, it's no surprise that you are hesitant.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
嗯... 是的。当然，你犹豫不决也不奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
But, if you don't take the warp that I open for you, you won't be able to get to the destination.
Please don't waste your energy.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
但是，如果你不使用我为你打开的传送门，
你就无法到达目的地。
请不要浪费体力。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Of course, no matter how comfortable you may be I wouldn't go there.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
当然，无论那里多么舒适，
我都不会去那里。

scripts.text: I am a scholar who came here to research the ruins here in Juperos.
scripts.translation:
我是一名学者，
来这里研究朱佩罗斯的遗迹。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
But... actually when I try to go further
I get scared. I can hardly go inside.
What can I do?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
但是... 实际上当我试图走得更远时，
我会感到害怕。我几乎不敢进去。
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
I heard a rumor that humans aren't welcome inside there.
But it should be very useful to study the marvelous machines in there.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
我听说里面不欢迎人类。
但研究里面那些神奇的机械应该很有用。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Umm? Are you also going to Juperos to get something?
I have no courage to go in there.
Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
嗯？你也是去朱佩罗斯找什么东西吗？
我没有勇气进去。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
I know the way to get to
the midway point and I also have
all the stuff I need. But I'm just too scared.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
我知道去中途点的路，
我也带齐了所有需要的东西。但我就是太害怕了。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
So if you want, I'll send you
to Juperos. Mr. Elder Scholar
has told me how to warp to
the midway point to Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
所以如果你愿意，我会送你去朱佩罗斯。
长老学者
告诉我如何传送到朱佩罗斯的中途点。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
It is true that it becomes easy
but you can't help the fear
it's too bad. Anyway if you are
ready to go please tell me.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
确实会容易一些，
但恐惧感是无法消除的。
真遗憾。总之，
如果你准备好了，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[?]
I've lost my body and all that's left is my spirit in this place.
I will live and die here in Juperos forever...
scripts.translation:
[?]
我已经失去了身体，
只剩下灵魂留在这里。
我将永远在朱佩罗斯
生与死...

scripts.text:
[?]
That appearance... Is it so? You also gained the knowledge.
When the future is full of possibilities...
An attitude of a pure child
like you can do anything...
scripts.translation:
[?]
那种姿态...是吗？
你也获得了知识。
当未来充满无限可能时...
像你这样纯净的心灵，
无所不能...

scripts.text:
[?]
Talented one.
Make sure there are
no enemies around.
If you focus on me,
you might get attacked.
scripts.translation:
[?]
有天赋的人。
请确保周围没有敌人。
如果你专注于我，
可能会遭到攻击。

scripts.text:
[?]
Come to think of it now the most precious thing right now might be getting confidence rather than knowledge itself...
scripts.translation:
[?]
现在回想起来，
此刻最珍贵的可能不是知识本身，
而是获得自信...

scripts.text:
[?]
Please don't make any
faults from now on as I did.
I hope you get knowledge
by yourself someday.
scripts.translation:
[?]
请不要再犯像我一样的错误。
我希望有一天，
你能自己获得知识。

scripts.text:
[?]
Well then go back, find a human who knows of magic machinery and show evidence that you've gained the knowledge...
scripts.translation:
[?]
那么回去吧，
找一个懂魔法机械的人类，
证明你获得了知识...

scripts.text:
[?]
I'm the one who lost my body
and my spirits are disrupted
I'm restricted to this place, Juperos... I will live and die with Juperos
Forever...
scripts.translation:
[?]
我是那个失去身体的人，
我的灵魂也支离破碎。
我被束缚在这个地方，朱佩罗斯...
我将与朱佩罗斯同生共死，
永远...

scripts.text:
[?]
My name... name is... Fr...
scripts.translation:
[?]
我的名字...名字是...弗...

scripts.text: Well then, later.
scripts.translation: 那么，再见。

scripts.text: Focus.
scripts.translation: 专注

scripts.text:
[?]
I was once a human scholar.
I wanted to know the limitation of science that humankind didn't know of, so I learned a lot of things, studied,
and searched...
scripts.translation:
[?]
我曾经是一名人类学者。
我想知道人类未知的科学极限，
于是我学习了很多东西，
研究，探索...

scripts.text:
[?]
That's when I discovered, the uncertain magical power.
scripts.translation:
[?]
就在那时，
我发现了不确定的魔力。

scripts.text:
[?]
The thing, with uncertain magic is that it is highly unstable and unpredictable.
During my studies I encountered a pocket of highly volatile magic.
scripts.translation:
[?]
不确定的魔力，
极不稳定且难以预测。
在我的研究中，
我遇到了一处高度不稳定的魔力聚集地。

scripts.text:
[?]
The only memories I have are from that day forward.
I've been trapped here since.
scripts.translation:
[?]
我仅存的记忆，
都是从那一天开始的。
从那以后，我就被困在这里了。

scripts.text:
[?]
Juperos is all that I know now.
I'm going to die here.
scripts.translation:
[?]
朱佩罗斯是我现在唯一知道的地方。
我将死在这里。

scripts.text:
[?]
I don't know who you are...
I won't bother to know if you
want to gain some knowledge
find someone who cares.
scripts.translation:
[?]
我不知道你是谁...
如果你想要获得知识，
去找关心你的人吧。

scripts.text:
[?]
Knowledge isn't obtained from others. It is found through one's own efforts.
Find your own knowledge path.
scripts.translation:
[?]
知识不是从他人那里获得的，
而是通过自己的努力找到的。
找到你自己的知识之路。

scripts.text:
[?]
Juperos... I...
Juperos... What I want
exists all in here...
The power of science...the paradise of machines...
scripts.translation:
[?]
朱佩罗斯...我...
朱佩罗斯...我想要的
都在这里...
科学的力量...机械的乐园...

scripts.text:
[?]
Talented one.
Make sure there are
no enemies around.
If you focus on me,
you might get attacked.
scripts.translation:
[?]
有天赋的人。
请确保周围没有敌人。
如果你专注于我，
可能会遭到攻击。

scripts.text: Well then, later
scripts.translation: 那么，下次再说

scripts.text: Focus
scripts.translation: 专注

scripts.text:
[?]
When I had a body
I wanted to prove the
excellence of science
to the ones who only believe
such occult things...
scripts.translation:
[?]
当我还有肉体时，
我想向那些只相信
神秘学的人证明，
科学才是卓越的...

scripts.text:
[?]
I wanted to use the power of
magic as a reasonable form
which is visible. With stronger
results, I wanted to control
the power of magic by
using science....
scripts.translation:
[?]
我想将魔法的力量
转化为一种可见的、
合理的形态。我想利用科学
来控制魔法的力量，
从而获得更强大的效果...

scripts.text:
[?]
I wanted to show that science
is excellent to control magic
like the occult. I studied a lot
of things and agonized over
making science and magic
co-exist.
scripts.translation:
[?]
我想证明，科学
能像神秘学一样
控制魔法。我研究了很多东西，
并痛苦地思考着
如何让科学与魔法共存。

scripts.text:
[?]
My research led me here,
Juperos. In this place there
are many products of science
that could stimulate a scholar's
brain...
scripts.translation:
[?]
我的研究将我带到了这里，
朱佩罗斯。在这个地方，
有许多科学产物，
足以刺激学者的头脑...

scripts.text:
[?]
I found that it was possible to join the power of magic with science.
Even if it wasn't perfect, it appealed enough to the other scholars...
scripts.translation:
[?]
我发现可以将魔法的力量
与科学结合。
即使并不完美，
这也足以吸引其他学者...

scripts.text:
[?]
The recent events of the world have created a confusion so my research hasn't been shared with the rest of the world.
scripts.translation:
[?]
最近世界发生的事件
造成了混乱，
所以我的研究
未能分享给世界其他地方。

scripts.text:
[?]
So... I came back to Juperos to continue my investigation of science and magic.
scripts.translation:
[?]
所以...我回到朱佩罗斯，
继续我对科学与魔法的研究。

scripts.text:
[?]
I want to know more about the knowledge...
the features of humans...
The things to be done first and later...
The door of truth will later...
scripts.translation:
[?]
我想知道更多关于知识的事...
人类的特征...
先做什么，后做什么...
真理之门将在未来...

scripts.text:
[?]
Talented one.
Make sure there are
no enemies around.
If you focus on me,
you might get attacked.
scripts.translation:
[?]
有天赋的人。
请确保周围没有敌人。
如果你专注于我，
可能会遭到攻击。

scripts.text: Well then, later
scripts.translation: 那么，下次再说

scripts.text: Focus
scripts.translation: 专注

scripts.text:
[?]
I wasn't satisfied with my success so I came back here time and time again.
scripts.translation:
[?]
我对自己的成功并不满足，
所以我一次又一次地回到这里。

scripts.text:
[?]
When I stepped on the foothold of this statue, the energy I had gathered and learned was absorbed.
scripts.translation:
[?]
当我踏上这座雕像的基座时，
我聚集和学到的能量被吸收了。

scripts.text:
[?]
But, with that energy being absorbed, I began to gain knowledge that I never knew previously.
scripts.translation:
[?]
但随着能量的吸收，
我开始获得以前从未知道的知识。

scripts.text:
[?]
But it came at a price. With the knowledge I started losing my humanity.
I lost my body and the only thing I had was my spirit.
scripts.translation:
[?]
但这付出了代价。随着知识的获得，
我开始失去人性。
我失去了肉体，
唯一剩下的就是我的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[?]
I don't regret gaining the knowledge. All I wish is that I could have my body back.
scripts.translation:
[?]
我不后悔获得知识。
我只是希望能找回我的肉体。

scripts.text:
[?]
After I had poured my energy into the statue, I figured that I could move my energy to different statues.
scripts.translation:
[?]
在我将能量注入雕像后，
我发现我可以将能量
转移到不同的雕像上。

scripts.text:
-Suddenly I feel power is-
-escaping my whole body-
-What is happening?-
scripts.translation:
-突然感觉力量从-
-全身流失-
-发生了什么？-

scripts.text:
-Find the door of truth-
-it is the source of the-
-power drain.-
scripts.translation:
-找到真理之门-
-它是能量流失的-
-源头。-

scripts.text:
-Suddenly, an unidentified-
-voice is ringing in my head-
-What is it?-
scripts.translation:
-突然，一个未知的-
-声音在我脑海中回响-
-那是什么？-

scripts.text:
-Handling machines-
-absorbing magic power-
-a sacrificial offering-
-the statue of a human.-
scripts.translation:
-操纵机器-
-吸收魔法力量-
-献祭-
-人类的雕像。-

scripts.text:
-Most certain of all is that-
-I started to feel the urge-
-to go to the door of truth.-
scripts.translation:
-最确定的一点是-
-我开始感到一种-
-前往真理之门的冲动。-

scripts.text:
-Suddenly I feel power is-
-escaping from my body-
-What is happening?-
scripts.translation:
-突然感觉力量从-
-身体中流失-
-发生了什么？-

scripts.text:
-I had a feeling that power-
-has been draining out,-
-but now, I do not-
-feel anything.-
scripts.translation:
-我原本感觉力量-
-一直在流失，-
-但现在，我-
-什么也感觉不到了。-

scripts.text:
-Go to the south of-
-the foothold quickly.-
scripts.translation:
-快去南方的-
-基座那里。-

scripts.text:
-Suddenly I feel power is-
-escaping from my body-
-What is happening?-
scripts.translation:
-突然感觉力量从-
-身体中流失-
-发生了什么？-

scripts.text:
-I feel my senses-
-are returning to me.-
scripts.translation:
-我感觉我的-
-感官正在恢复。-

scripts.text:
-I think that I am becoming-
-the sacrificial offering.-
scripts.translation:
-我想，我正在变成-
-祭品。-

scripts.text:
-Suddenly I feel power is-
-escaping from my body-
-What is happening?-
scripts.translation:
-突然感觉力量从-
-身体中流失-
-发生了什么？-

scripts.text:
-Once again a voice rings out-
-in my head. This time it is-
-different than before, it is a-
-voice of an impressive person.-
scripts.translation:
-脑海中再次响起-
-一个声音。这次-
-与之前不同，-
-那是一个令人印象深刻-
-的人的声音。-

scripts.text:
I know you came this far because you want the knowledge.
Humans are weak animals
and any sacrifice is a hard
decision for them to make.
scripts.translation:
我知道你走到这里，是因为你渴望知识。
人类是脆弱的生物，
任何牺牲对他们来说
都是艰难的决定。

scripts.text:
But you are lacking something to pass through this door of truth.
Through this door is knowledge above all human thinking.
scripts.translation:
但你缺少通过这扇真理之门的东西。
门后是超越人类思维的知识。

scripts.text: It won't harm a human's mind if it doesn't surpass your brain capacity.
scripts.translation:
只要不超过你的大脑容量，
它就不会伤害人类的心智。

scripts.text: Try to put your body onto the foothold of knowledge at the south.
scripts.translation:
试着将你的身体放到
南方的知识基座上。

scripts.text:
If the knowledge suits you, you'll be able to obtain it without becoming a sacrificial offering.
If you are unqualified, you will lose your body as a sacrifice.
scripts.translation:
如果知识适合你，你就能在不成为祭品的情况下获得它。
如果你不合格，你就会失去身体作为祭品。

scripts.text:
When you are qualified, you will be able to pass through the door of truth.
Till that day, don't lose yourself.
scripts.translation:
当你合格时，你就能通过真理之门。
在那一天到来之前，不要迷失自我。

scripts.text:
-I can't hear any voices-
-anymore and I can't feel-
-anything in this place.-
scripts.translation:
-我听不到任何-
-声音了，也感觉不到-
-这个地方的任何-
-东西。-

scripts.text:
-As the ringing voice in my-
-head instructed, let's go to-
-the southern foothold.-
scripts.translation:
-按照脑海中-
-回响的声音的指示，-
-让我们去南方的-
-基座吧。-

scripts.text:
-The moment I stepped on-
-the foothold the voice-
-didn't come into my brain-
-rather new knowledge-
-came in naturally.-
scripts.translation:
-当我踏上基座的-
-那一刻，声音-
-并没有进入我的大脑，-
-而是新的知识-
-自然地涌了进来。-

scripts.text:
-Almost instantaneously-
-you gained all of the-
-knowledge that you need-
-to know about mechanics-
-and magic machinery.-
scripts.translation:
-几乎瞬间-
-你就获得了所有-
-关于机匠和-
-魔法机械的知识。-

scripts.text:
-This amount of knowledge-
-is enough. Let's get finished-
-and find a way out.-
scripts.translation:
-这些知识-
-已经足够了。让我们-
-结束这一切，-
-找到出路。-
